artworks.title: Pierre Seguier
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly to the left with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a long nose, a pointed goatee, arched eyebrows, deep-set eyes, curly hair, and is dressed in historical attire with an elaborate vest and wide white collar. There are decorative elements around him, including scrolls and a heraldry cartouche at the bottom. The background has subtle shading for depth.

artworks.title: Pierre Seguier
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 29.2 x 20.5 cm (11 1/2 x 8 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man named PETRVS SEGVIER. He is depicted from the upper half of his body facing slightly left but looking forward, with a subtle smile. He has a defined mustache and beard, curly shoulder-length hair, and is dressed in formal attire with a white collar, dark garment, and decorative buttons. The ornate frame surrounding him features inscriptions, including his name, and a coat of arms at the bottom. The background consists of engraved lines.

artworks.title: Pierre de Ronsard
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man's upper body in profile, facing right. The man has distinct facial features including a prominent nose, strong chin, a beard, short curly hair, and a laurel wreath on his head. He is wearing a draped toga-like garment secured by a brooch on his shoulder. There are no visible jewelry pieces. The background is plain with engraving lines, enclosed in an oval border with decorative elements at the top. The text "MYRTO ET LAURO" is seen above, and the bottom identifies the man as Pierre de Ronsard with additional French text. The entire portrait has an aged appearance typical of historical engravings.

artworks.title: Armand Jean du Plessis, Cardinal Richelieu
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with a distinguished appearance. They are positioned slightly to the side with their head turned toward the viewer. The person has a slender face, a pointed beard, mustache, and long, light hair falling to about the collar. They wear a clerical robe with a broad, white, pointed collar and a necklace with a large, ornate pendant resembling a star. The background is a textured, shaded surface resembling draped fabric. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate frame with a repeating pattern.

artworks.title: Armand Jean du Plessis, Cardinal Richelieu
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man with sharp facial features, including a narrow nose and a pointy chin. He has a trimmed mustache and goatee, curly hair cropped around the ears, and a tall cap with a prominent peak. He wears a robe with a large collar and buttons down the front. The background has textured lines forming an oval frame, with a description of the subject's name and titles below.

artworks.title: François La Rochefoucauld
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a man facing forward. He has a prominent brow, piercing eyes, a pointed beard with a mustache, and his hair is covered by a pointed cap. The man is wearing a robe with a wide collar and intricate button details, along with an elaborate necklace. The background features a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Armand Jean du Plessis, Cardinal Richelieu
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 23.7 x 17.5 cm (9 5/16 x 6 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in an ornate high-backed chair. He is facing forward with both arms on the armrests. The man has distinct facial features, including a pointed beard and mustache, with styled, curly hair. He is wearing a hat and ecclesiastical robes with intricate details. The background displays draped curtains. The chair has classical designs.

artworks.title: Armand Jean du Plessis, Cardinal Richelieu
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 19.9 x 14 cm (7 13/16 x 5 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a portrait of a man depicted from the upper body, slightly turned to the right. He has a defined face with high cheekbones, a pointed goatee, and a mustache. His hair is medium length, wavy, and parted down the middle. He wears a skullcap and is dressed in elaborate clothing with a wide stiff collar, a patterned garment, and a medal with a decorative cross around his neck. The portrait is framed by an ornate oval wreath, and below it, there is a scroll with the inscription "SEMPER IDEM." Surrounding the frame are decorative elements, including two books on either side and a rolled paper.

artworks.title: François La Rochefoucauld
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 4.3 x 4.5 cm (1 11/16 x 1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring the head and upper torso of a man named Cardinal Rupifucald. The man is facing slightly to the right with detailed facial features, a beard, a mustache, deep-set eyes, and a furrowed brow. He is wearing religious attire, including a cape and a high-collared garment with a cross insignia. The background is plain with a circular border framing the cardinal.

artworks.title: François La Rochefoucauld
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up facing forward with his head slightly turned to the left. He has distinct facial features including a prominent brow, deep-set eyes, wide nose, and a subtle smile with a neatly trimmed mustache and small beard. He has somewhat curly hair under a squared cap. The man is wearing priestly attire, including a high-collared shirt, buttoned garment, and cloak. He has a chain around his neck with a large cross-shaped medallion. The background is plain, and the image is enclosed in an oval frame.

artworks.title: N. Paget
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in a seated position. He is facing slightly to his right, with a calm expression. The man has a mustache, goatee, curly hair, and is wearing dark formal attire with a white collar. The background features an oval frame with a coat of arms below the portrait.

artworks.title: René Moreau
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man in a chair, with distinctive facial features, wearing a dark robe with a white collar. He is holding a closed book in his right hand and his left hand rests on the chair's arm. The background shows architectural details, suggesting a formal setting. The image is detailed with fine lines.

artworks.title: Henry II, Duke of Montmorency
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17.4 x 11.5 cm (6 7/8 x 4 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man with distinct facial features, curly hair, medium length, and an outfit with a lace collar and armor. Surrounding the portrait is a decorative frame with text indicating the subject as Henry Dvc de Montmorency in French. The background has textured horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Jacques de Charron
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man seated sideways, with his upper body turned towards the viewer. He has distinctive facial features, including a moustache and a short beard. His hair is long and wavy. The man is dressed in a richly decorated garment with intricate patterns and a high collar. He wears a cloak over his shoulders and holds a sword hilt. The background has horizontal lines and a coat of arms in the top right corner. An inscription at the bottom provides the man's name, Jacques de Charron, and additional information.

artworks.title: Charles Bernard
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the torso up, centered within an ornate oval frame. He is facing slightly towards the right but looking directly at the viewer. The man has a furrowed brow, deep-set eyes, a long nose, and a small goatee and mustache. His hair is light-colored, styled with waves, and receding. He is wearing a dark, buttoned garment with a white collar. There are no visible jewelry or objects on him. The background consists of a textured pattern surrounding the oval frame, as well as a scroll-like design and text encircling the portrait.

artworks.title: Etienne Binet
artworks.artist: Michel Lasne after Charles Le Brun
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body. The man is facing slightly to the left, looking directly at the viewer. He appears older with prominent cheekbones, a defined nose, and deep-set eyes. His hair is short and thinning at the top, with some strands around the sides. He has a light, closely-trimmed beard and mustache. He is wearing a formal robe or clerical attire with a high collar adorned with lace and embroidery. The background is a plain, dark, textured surface. There is a band of text below the portrait, which is unreadable in this description.

artworks.title: François de Beauvillier
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body and head. He is facing forward but slightly turned to his left. The man has a large mole on his left cheek, long curly hair reaching his shoulders, and is wearing what looks like armor with ornate detailing. A lace collar is visible underneath. The portrait is enclosed in an elaborate oval frame against a backdrop with shaded lines for depth. Below the portrait, there are decorative elements, inscriptions, and a crest set against an aged parchment-like background.

artworks.title: Henri de Beringhen
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man shown from the waist up, standing in a three-quarter view. He has long, wavy hair and a distinct mustache. He is dressed in elaborate armor with ornate detailing, including a decorative lace collar and a sash draped over his shoulder. The background features an oval frame encircling his portrait with a coat of arms below and two upright lions on each side. The style is indicative of formal historical portraits.

artworks.title: Anne of Austria
artworks.description: The image shows a woman with curly hair, wearing an ornate headpiece and detailed garment with a high lace collar. She has pendulous earrings, a brooch, and a large necklace. She is within a circular frame, with a textured background. Below her portrait, the text "ANNA AUSTR.REG.FRAN.ET.NAV" is inscribed. The style is reminiscent of historical engravings.

artworks.title: Michel de Marillac
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man's body. The man is facing forward with his head slightly turned to his right. He has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose, high cheekbones, and full lips. He has a mustache and a pointed beard. His hair is styled neatly under a cap or skullcap. He is dressed in a garment with a high, wide collar and a buttoned vest. The background is shaded, emphasizing the figure. Below the figure is an ornate coat of arms with text that identifies the individual as Michael de Marillac, Chancellor of France.

artworks.title: Louis de Marillac, Duke of Beaufort
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a man in formal clothing seated in a slightly angled position. He has pronounced facial features, including a mustache and beard, curly hair styled away from his face, and is wearing a garment with elaborate embroidery and a high lace collar. There is an ornate decoration or medal on his chest, and the background consists of a textured pattern. The caption below the portrait identifies him as M. Lovis Mareschal de Marillac de France.

artworks.title: Pierre de Marcassus
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18.7 x 11.7 cm (7 3/8 x 4 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man positioned directly towards the viewer. He has a pointed mustache, a small goatee, curly hair falling around his shoulders, and sharp facial features. He is dressed in an elaborate garment with vertical stripes and a large ruffled collar typical of the period style. The background consists of a detailed oval frame enclosing the portrait, with the name "PIERRE DE MARCASSVS" inscribed below. The engraving style of the artwork adds a rich texture to both the subject and the surrounding space.

artworks.title: Louis Sieur de Maine
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 19.6 x 14.5 cm (7 11/16 x 5 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This image shows a bust portrait of a man within an oval frame. The man has distinguished facial features, including a prominent nose, a slight smile, a mustache, and a goatee. His hair is curly and shoulder-length. He wears period attire with a lace collar and a garment that looks like a mix of armor and fabric, with visible straps and shoulder pads. There is a belt or strap across his chest. The background has a simple, hatched pattern. The style of the image is classical and engraved.

artworks.title: Jean Loret
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 20.3 x 14.4 cm (8 x 5 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the waist up. The person is positioned slightly turned to their right, with a mustache and long, wavy hair. Their expression is neutral. They wear a garment with intricate details like a lace collar and a coat with decorative trim and buttons. The background has an engraved pattern. Below the image, there is a text plate with French writing.
